subject: Pilot demo — request to realign timing after exec priority shift
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Monroe <alicia@streampath.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot demo scheduled — Tue 2027-06-08 10:00 PT / Pilot brief attached

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for coordinating — confirmed for tomorrow, Tue 2027-06-08 at 10:00 PT. I attached the short pilot brief (pilot-brief-v2.pdf) so your team can scan before we jump on. Plan for 30 minutes: a quick run-through of the integration surface, performance expectations, and a proposed mutual action plan.

Agenda (high level)
- 5m intros and priorities
- 15m demo with a short run of a 5k-token scenario
- 10m rollout & next steps (security, timeline, pricing)

If anything changes, give me a heads up and we can pivot. Calendar invite is on the way.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Principal Solutions, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Attachment: pilot-brief-v2.pdf (PDF, 420 KB)

From: Alicia Monroe <alicia@streampath.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Vega <t.vega@streampath.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 17:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot demo scheduled — Tue 2027-06-08 10:00 PT / Pilot brief attached

Vivek —

Really sorry to do this last minute, but we've had an executive schedule shift tied to a customer all-hands; our Head of Product and two leads will have to travel and won't be available tomorrow. Given this is the core decision group for the pilot, we need to push the session. Apologies for the short notice — this came up internally this morning.

Two notes:
1) We still want to move forward; this is a timing issue, not a change in priority.
2) Could we look at shifting to next week or, if easier, you could send a 12–15 minute recorded walkthrough we can watch asynchronously and then sync for a shorter decision call when the execs are back?

Thanks for understanding.

—
Alicia Monroe
Director of Product, Streampath
alicia@streampath.com | +1 212-555-0124

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Monroe <alicia@streampath.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot demo scheduled — quick options to keep momentum

On Mon, Jun 7, 2027 at 5:42 PM Alicia Monroe <alicia@streampath.com> wrote:
> Vivek —
>
> Really sorry to do this last minute, but we've had an executive schedule shift tied to a customer all-hands; our Head of Product and two leads will have to travel and won't be available tomorrow.
>
Thanks for the update, Alicia — no problem. Totally understand. Two practical options to keep momentum without tying up the exec calendar tomorrow:

Option A — Async + short decision call- I can record a 12–15 minute demo (recording + short notes) and drop it in a shared link today. Your team can watch when convenient; we then schedule a 20-minute exec-only decision call next week to confirm pilot scope.

Option B — Move the live demo to a time that includes the execs next week. I've proposed a few slots here: https://calendly.com/redwood/vivek-30 (feel free to pick one) — if you'd like, Marissa (cc'd) can also list a couple of times we know work on our side and I can block immediately.

Either is fine with us; if you're leaning async, I'll finish the recording tonight and include a one-page summary of expected outcomes and measurement criteria for the pilot.

I'll hold the calendar invite for tomorrow for now and cancel once we lock a new plan.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Principal Solutions, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Attachment: followup-recording-link.txt (will contain viewer URL once uploaded)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Monroe <alicia@streampath.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot demo — a couple of shortlist times next week

Hi Alicia —

Adding a couple of specific windows to make picking easier on both sides. All times PT:
- Wed 2027-06-09: 10:00–10:30 or 15:00–15:30
- Thu 2027-06-10: 09:00–09:30 or 13:30–14:00

If none of these work, tell me 2x windows that are good for the execs and I'll find matching slots on our side. If you prefer the recording option, we can drop that in today and include a 20-minute exec sync for next Tue (2027-06-15) — whichever helps keep momentum.

Quick logistics note: for the pilot we usually provision a short test key and a small sandbox dataset; if you want that ready for the live session, let us know the lead engineer's email and we'll pre-provision.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Direct: (650) 555-0233

Thanks for the options. Wed 2027-06-09 15:00 PT works for our group (execs confirmed). Please cancel tomorrow's invite and send the new calendar—we'd like the live demo so the execs can ask product/strategy questions in real time.

Lead engineer for sandbox provisioning: Tom Vega (t.vega@streampath.com).

Appreciate the flexibility — looking forward to the session.
